analysis.title: Crocs Inc. (CROX): 3Q26 First Take: Strong 3Q beat; FY guidance raised
key_insights: CROX reported 3Q26 adjusted EPS of $3.69 vs GS/FactSet consensus of $3.30/$3.31. Net revenue rose 4.6% Y/Y (+4.6% ex-FX) to $1,042.6mn vs GS/consensus of +0.8%/+0.7%.
Adjusted EBIT margin was 22.3% vs GS/consensus of 21.6%/21.7%. Adjusted gross margin rose about 180bps Y/Y to 60.3% and adjusted SG&A was 38.1% of sales vs GS/consensus of 38.7%/38.3%.
CROX raised FY26 adjusted EPS guidance to $14.45-$14.65 from $13.70-$14.00, vs GS/consensus of $14.02/$13.96. FY26 revenue is now expected to rise about 3% (prior +1% to +2%).
FY26 Crocs brand revenue guidance is now +4% (prior +2% to +3%). HEYDUDE revenue is now expected to be flat (prior -4% to -2%). Operating margin guidance was raised to modest expansion from 22.5%.

4Q26 guidance: adjusted EPS $3.25-$3.45 vs GS/FactSet consensus of $3.17/$3.11. Revenue is expected to rise 7-9% vs GS/consensus of 2.7%/3.8%. Adjusted operating margin is expected at 20.5% vs GS/consensus of 20.4%/20.6%.
4Q26 brand guidance: Crocs brand revenue +6-8% vs GS/consensus of 1.8%/4.2%. HEYDUDE revenue +10-12% vs GS/consensus of 6.3%/5.2%.

GS calls it a strong print with breadth across both brands and better margins, and says share repurchases were a bright spot. GS expects the results and outlook to be well received given muted investor expectations for the footwear sector.
Crocs brand North America declined 2.1% Y/Y in fiscal 3Q and remains under pressure overall. GS notes some noise from a partner channel shift and wants more color on the call.
Crocs brand segments vs GSe: North America DTC -0.7% Y/Y vs -5.1%, North America wholesale -4.9% vs +2.2%, International DTC +24.1% vs +13.4%, International wholesale +2.3% vs +0.6%.
HEYDUDE sales rose 6.1% Y/Y to $169.9mn vs GS/consensus of -2.4%/-1.6%. Wholesale rose 14.0% vs GSe of -12.0%, and DTC rose 0.1% vs GSe of +5.0%.
CROX is not embedding tariff refunds in FY26 guidance or non-GAAP numbers, which GS says creates a cleaner base for FY27.
Inventories rose 4.0% Y/Y to $413mn vs GSe of +2.2%. Diluted shares were 48.0mn vs 54.0mn a year earlier.
GS keeps a Sell rating and a $95 12-month price target (5.0x Q5-Q8 EV/EBITDA) against a $119.69 price as of 28 Oct 2026, implying 20.6% downside. GS FY26E EPS is $14.02.

Call questions GS will press: drivers of Crocs brand performance and North America stabilization, HEYDUDE progress, gross margin and SG&A drivers into 4Q, assumptions in the FY26 outlook, and plans for rising raw material and fuel costs into FY27 including pricing and cost savings.

market_movers.rationale: GS stays Sell with a $95 target, 20.6% below the $119.69 price, despite calling the 3Q beat and raised guidance strong. The target rests on 5.0x Q5-Q8 EV/EBITDA.

sector_views.rationale: GS describes investor expectations for the footwear sector as muted, which it expects to help the reception of CROX's better results and outlook.

earnings_insights: 3Q26 (reported 10/29): adjusted EPS $3.69 vs GS consensus $3.30 and FactSet consensus $3.31. GAAP EPS was $4.52 vs 3Q25 GAAP EPS of $2.70, including a one-time item of +$0.83.
3Q26 net sales were $1,042.6mn, +4.6% Y/Y, vs GSe of $1,004.1mn. Crocs brand sales were $872.7mn (+4.4%) and HEYDUDE sales were $169.9mn (+6.1%).
3Q26 adjusted EBIT was $232.0mn (22.3% margin) vs GSe of $216.5mn (21.6%). Adjusted net income was about $177.0mn vs GSe of $159.9mn.
FY26 guidance raised: adjusted EPS $14.45-$14.65 (prior $13.70-$14.00) vs GS estimate of $14.02 and FactSet consensus of $13.96. Revenue about +3% (prior +1% to +2%).
4Q26 guidance (company expectation): adjusted EPS $3.25-$3.45 vs GS estimate of $3.17 and FactSet consensus of $3.11. Revenue +7-9% vs GS estimate of 2.7% and consensus of 3.8%.
GS estimates after the print (pre-print figures): FY26E EPS $14.02, FY27E $15.33, FY28E $16.53, with FY26E revenue of $4,088.3mn.
risk_factors: GS lists upside risks to its Sell rating: better-than-expected execution in the core US business, faster scaling of non-core businesses, and an attractive free cash flow profile amid increased macro volatility.
Crocs brand North America remains under pressure, with a 2.1% Y/Y decline in fiscal 3Q.
Raw material and fuel costs are rising into FY27, and the plan for pricing and further cost savings is not yet known.

tension_points.bull_case: GS calls it a strong print with a beat across the P&L, raised FY26 and 4Q guidance, and HEYDUDE returning to growth, and expects the results to be well received given muted sector expectations.
tension_points.bear_case: Crocs brand North America fell 2.1% Y/Y in fiscal 3Q and remains under pressure, and GS keeps a Sell rating with a $95 target well below the $119.69 price.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Better-than-expected execution in the core US business, which GS lists as an upside risk to its Sell rating.
